title: Medication Safety Copilot
short: AI-assisted prescription review that flags likely errors before they reach the patient.
problem: Wrong doses, duplicates and look-alike mix-ups slip past busy pharmacists.
why: Medication errors are a leading preventable cause of patient harm.
solution: An assistant that reviews each prescription against the patient profile and returns a short, sourced list of concerns.
limitations: Needs local formulary data for Jordan

references.title: WHO — Medication Without Harm (Global Patient Safety Challenge)
ISMP — Institute for Safe Medication Practices

symptom: Errors slip through the prescription queue
ingredient: An AI second check on every prescription
directions: Runs on each prescription. Flags the risk, cites the source, leaves the decision to the pharmacist.
data: Patient profile (age, weight, renal function, allergies)
Approved dosing references and local formulary
review: The pharmacist accepts or dismisses every alert and makes the dispensing decision.
